patthana14.15:1.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto ca na āsavavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.15:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto ca na āsavavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.15:3.1: āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavasampayuttañca āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto ca na āsavavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.15:4.1: hetuyā nava sabbattha nava. āsavasāsavaduke naāsavasāsavadukaṃ
